//: Example ~/.shipd-config.json for /s:build. Copy to ~/.shipd-config.json and edit. All keys are optional; the build telemetry settings live under the `build` key, and unknown keys are ignored. Values shown are the defaults.
// autonomous-pipeline: Optional top-level key declaring the delivery pipeline: a preset name ("default", "eco", "basic") or an ordered list of stage entries. Omitted here so copying this file declares no pipeline; the full grammar lives in the content directory's README.md ('The autonomous pipeline' section).
// pr-mode: Optional top-level key choosing how a change's PR ships: "auto" (the default when omitted — an auto-merging PR) or "draft" (a draft PR, no auto-merge, a human merges). Omitted here so copying this file declares no mode; usually declared once at a workspace root, and documented in the content directory's README.md ('PR mode' section).
// guardrails: Optional top-level key holding the guardrail hook's kill-switches: `false` turns the hook off, or an object with `disable` (rule names to drop). The rules themselves are markdown files, not config — `<content-dir>/rules/*.md` in the repo, `~/.shipd/rules/*.md` for every repo, and the plugin's own `hooks/rules/*.md` built-ins, first source winning a name. Omitted here so copying this file declares nothing and the three built-in comment rules stay active; the rule file format and both modes (`deny`, `remind`) are documented in the content directory's README.md ('Guardrails' section).
